fk.tool_axis: directed local Z expressed in base

dataset_generation.strategy: 75% nearby normal delta sigma=0.35 rad; 25% independent uniform goals; reject invalid/unrepresentable pairs

training.witness_loss: separate best-of-four normalized joint distance to FK witness; no joint-label averaging

collision_training.loss: Mean normalized joint-distance to a known safe FK witness over native-checker-invalid proposals only; zero if all are safe
collision_training.gradient: Detached exact validity mask plus differentiable witness repair; not a signed-distance gradient
collision_training.scope: Endpoint self-collision; no environment or trajectory guarantee

training.objective: best-of-four task costs + travel/witness regularizers + audited self-collision repair; no averaging joint labels

validation_metrics.limitation: One reproducible training seed; benchmark before relying on quality
